constructive_questions.Name: CQ1
constructive_questions.Details: In binary search, when the number of sorted data values is quadrupled, how much does the maximum number of comparisons increase by. Explain the characteristics of each of the sorting methods: shell sort, bubble sort, quick sort, and heap sort?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ1
constructive_questions.Details: Compare DRAM and SRAM. Among the components that compose a computer, which ones compose the central processing unit (CPU)?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ1
constructive_questions.Details: Explain the role of cache memory. Describe the characteristics of RAID. Is USB a serial interface or a parallel interface, why?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ1
constructive_questions.Details: Explain the roles of task management. What type of file organization is this? Sequential organization files are grouped into units called memebers, each of which is given a name. A directory is created, including these names and leading addresses, and access is allowed to these members. Explain swapping. What is the unit of loading into the main memory in the page method?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ1
constructive_questions.Details: Explain the roles of clients and servers in a client/server system. What is the difference between batch processing and real-time processing?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ1
constructive_questions.Details: Explain the meanings of the following terms: "MIPS", "response time", "throughput" and "turn-around time". Explain the maining of RASIS. Explain the meanings of MTBF and MTTR. Express the availability using MTBF and MTTR?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ1
constructive_questions.Details: What is an intranet. What is a data warehouse?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ1
constructive_questions.Details: List programming languages that are each classified as "procedural", "functional", "logic", and "object-oriented". Explain "reentrant". What are the types of language processor. List three typical process models and explain the characteristics of each. List two differences between inspection and walk-through?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ1
constructive_questions.Details: List the types of tasks done in external and internal design. To increase the level of independence of modules, what should one do with module strength and module coupling, also, name the thype of strength and coupling referred to here?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ1
constructive_questions.Details: Describe briefly each of the following checking methods: numeric check, format check, limit check, range check, and sequence check. Describe the characteristics of a black box and a white box test?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ1
constructive_questions.Details: List the mothods of synchronization control. Describe the characteristics of packet exchange?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ1
constructive_questions.Details: Explain the CSMA/CD method. List three basic services of the Internet and explain each. Describe the channel structure of the basic interface of ISDN?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ1
constructive_questions.Details: List the three-layer schema and explain the roles of each schema. List logical data models and explain briefly the characteristics of each. Describe the characteristics of first, second and third normal forms. List the types of relational operations and explain the process of each?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ1
constructive_questions.Details: Explain the roles of DDL and DML. Explain the cursor function?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ1
constructive_questions.Details: List what is necessary for recovery when a database fails due to a transaction failure. What is this recovery method called. Explain the two-phase commitment?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ1
constructive_questions.Details: Explain the differences between private key and public key cryptography. In general, a computer virus is defined as having at least one of three functions. List the three functions?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ1
constructive_questions.Details: Describe the contents of the ISO 9000 series. What is the compression format for color still images and moving pictures?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ1
constructive_questions.Details: Explain what CIO is. Give the general procedure of the KJ method. List the four principles of brainstorming and explain BPR?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ1
constructive_questions.Details: Explain ABC analysis. Explain CAD. What is the name of the card system whereby payments can be made by a bank-issued cash card and the money is immediately paid?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ1
constructive_questions.Details: Explain the types and characteristics of typical information systems used in business area?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ1
constructive_questions.Details: Explain the purposes and basic mechanisms of automatic production control, production systems, production management, and computer-aided systems?
